content.title: 23 Stores Open on Easter Sunday in 2025 (and 8 That Will Be Closed)
content.text: Easter Sunday is coming up quickly, and whether you’re cooking big-batch recipes or planning an intimate Easter dinner, it can be hard to find last-minute supplies. Sure, you could throw together something tasty with pantry staples, but if your favorite dish calls for something special, you’ll need to go for a drive. And at the very least, you may be craving some last-minute Easter candy. Have no fear! Rather than arriving empty-handed to a party or driving around searching for an open store, we’ve rounded up the grocery stores that will be open on Easter, and noted the ones you should skip. And if you don’t feel like cooking, you can also check out the best places for Easter dinner delivery. Stores Open on Easter Acme: Stores are open from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m., however pharmacy hours may vary. Albertsons: Most locations will be open during normal business hours this holiday. BJ’s: The wholesale store will be open for Easter. CVS: All your convenience needs will still be accessible from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. Dollar General: This budget-friendly store will be operating during its regular hours. Family Dollar: The store will be open, but hours may vary, so make sure to check online or call ahead. Harris Teeter: You can get your last-minute grocery needs during Harris Teeter’s normal business hours. Jewel-Osco: This Illinois-centered store will be open on Easter Sunday. Kroger: Stores will be open between 6 a.m. and 9 p.m., but the pharmacies will be closed. Meijer: Hours will vary by location on Easter, so give your local store a call to hear its hours. Piggly Wiggly: This grocery store will be open, but will close early at 4 p.m. RiteAid: The one-stop shop will be open on Easter Sunday, but hours will vary by location. Safeway: If you need any missing ingredients, make a quick stop at Safeway this Easter. Stores will be open, but the hours will vary. ShopRite: ShopRite stores will be open for the holiday, with hours varying by location. Stop & Shop: You can rely on Stop & Shop to be open on Easter this year. Sprouts: The store will be open for the holiday—perfect for getting last-minute fresh, organic fruits and vegetables for your Easter dinner. Trader Joe’s: Your favorite place for snacks, appetizers and more will be open on Easter day. Vons: Most Vons stores will be open between 6 a.m. to 8 p.m. Walgreens: Stop at your local Walgreens for a quick grab on Easter. Hours will vary by location. Walmart: Most Walmart locations will remain open this Easter during regular hours. Wegmans: Most Wegmans grocery stores will be open from 6 a.m. to 8 p.m. Whole Foods: Stores will be open with hours varying by location. Winn Dixie: Hours will vary by location for this store, but most should be open on Easter Sunday. Stores Closed on Easter While many chains will be open on Easter, others, like Target and Aldi, are giving their hard-working employees a day off. Aldi Central Market Costco Food City H-E-B Publix Sam’s Club Target For stores with varying hours, or for information on your local mom-and-pop shop, call or visit their website for exact hours.
